description: This file defines the GatewayEventHandler class which manages wake word synchronization between a local preferences store and a remote gateway via network requests. It includes methods for applying, scheduling, and refreshing wake words, and handles voice wake change events.

classes.name: GatewayEventHandler
classes.description: Manages wake word synchronization and handles voice wake change events, coordinating local preferences with remote gateway sessions, using coroutines for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: applyWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Saves the provided list of wake words to preferences and temporarily suppresses wake word sync to avoid recursive updates.

methods.name: scheduleWakeWordsSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed sync of wake words to the gateway, cancelling any existing scheduled syncs. Bails out if not connected or if suppress flag is set.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches current wake words from the gateway and applies them locally, parsing the response JSON safely.

methods.name: handleVoiceWakeChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming voice wake change events in JSON format, extracting trigger words and applying them locally.
